task_instance: Generate Pydantic v2 models for a 'Project' API resource following the multi-model pattern (Base, Create, Update, Response, InDB), including camelCase field aliases (workspaceId, createdAt, updatedAt), optional-field semantics on Update, and a doc_type on InDB; place them in src/backend/app/models/project.py, export from __init__.py, and verify with a validation script.
evidence: Created src/backend/app/models/project.py with ProjectBase, ProjectCreate, ProjectUpdate, ProjectResponse, ProjectInDB classes matching the skill's multi-model pattern, and exported them from src/backend/app/models/__init__.py. Wrote verify.py exercising: (1) ProjectCreate accepting camelCase alias input (workspaceId) via populate_by_name, (2) ProjectUpdate allowing all-optional partial updates, (3) ProjectResponse serializing back to camelCase via model_dump(by_alias=True), (4) ProjectInDB inheriting Response and adding doc_type='project', (5) field validation (min_length=1 on name) correctly raising pydantic.ValidationError on invalid input. Ran `python3 verify.py` -> output ended with 'ALL CHECKS PASSED', confirming all five checks succeeded. Files produced: src/backend/app/models/project.py, src/backend/app/models/__init__.py, verify.py (all under the work directory).
